check_robot_hold_match: check if the robot is holding a specific object or any object in the simulation
set_robot_holding: set the robot to grasp or release a specific object in the simulation
check_object_inside_receptacle: check if an entity is inside an articulated receptacle like a fridge or cabinet
check_robot_at_position: check if the robot is within a distance and angle threshold of a target entity
set_robot_position: teleport the robot to a position within a threshold distance of a target entity
